title: ESSX Jobs
description: ESSX Jobs adds a bunch of jobs with different xp gains and coins! Level up and earn even more perks coins xp and more! now availible the shop!
body:
# ESSX Jobs
is a server side mod which adds jobs with xp gains and coins you can spend in a shop or trade with other players.
![job list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c36df23aa75f58a29b8541a9c8a098c9d275986a_0.webp)
![shop example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c11fe5e9a26ca6afa366279802a097daf0a59ec1.png)

## Job commands
- /job list - shows a list of availibe jobs
- /job give <player> <job> - give a player a job
- /job remove <player> - remove a job from a player
- /job info <job> - see what jobs get you
- /job top - see the top players in jobs
- /job players - see the jobs given to the players

now much simpler with /jobs or if you have the mod installed on your client press J to open the job gui where you can select a job or remove it also you can now look up the guide book and i also added a leaderboard to see who is the best!
![/jobs chest gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3a402b3ffd8338d5124d823dd37b1c77f4d3c20_0.webp)
![guide book ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4adc15c9d2848ea3afd7171570d3272410b17c35_0.webp)

## Shop update
- /shop - opens the customizable admin shop
![admin shop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d929c7b26cd58d9f5fce846e6a83dca9a870547_0.webp)


custom player sign shop looks like this:
![sign shop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef1f969009b4c325cb7e466f508993569516bbee_0.webp)

first line is the activator
second line is the item you wanna sell
third line is the amount:price

- [ESSX SHOP]
- diamond_block (optional, if empty it fills automaticly)
- 16:2

The sign needs to be on a chest with the items you wanna sell in it!
You have to rightclick the sign when you are done and the first line should be blue now!
If the chest is empty the shop owners name in the last line on the sign will be replaced with a red SOLD OUT so you know when to refill!
If you want to remove a shop you simply sneak and breake it.
